option.value:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <ScrollView xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:padding="24dp">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:gravity="center_horizontal">
<FrameLayout android:layout_width="96dp" android:layout_height="96dp" android:background="@drawable/profile_photo_border" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp">
<ImageView android:id="@+id/ivProfilePhoto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:src="@drawable/ic_user_placeholder" android:scaleType="centerCrop" android:contentDescription="Foto de perfil" android:padding="4dp" /> </FrameLayout>
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvFullName" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Nombre Apellido" android:textAlignment="center" android:gravity="center" android:textSize="20sp" android:textStyle="normal" android:fontFamily="@font/nunito_light" android:textColor="#230000" android:layout_marginBottom="4dp" />
<EditText android:id="@+id/etFirstName" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:hint="Nombre" android:textColor="#230000" android:textAlignment="center" android:gravity="center" android:textSize="20sp" android:textStyle="normal" android:fontFamily="@font/nunito_light" android:visibility="gone" android:layout_marginBottom="2dp" />
<EditText android:id="@+id/etLastName" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:hint="Apellido" android:textColor="#230000" android:textAlignment="center" android:gravity="center" android:textSize="20sp" android:textStyle="normal" android:fontFamily="@font/nunito_light" android:visibility="gone" android:layout_marginBottom="4dp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvEmail" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="email@ejemplo.com" android:textColor="#230000" android:textAlignment="center" android:gravity="center" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:textSize="16sp" android:textStyle="normal" android:fontFamily="@font/nunito_light" />
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/btnEditProfile" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Modificar" style="@style/NunitoBoldButtonRounded" android:layout_marginTop="0dp" android:layout_marginStart="24dp" android:layout_marginEnd="24dp" android:layout_gravity="center_horizontal" android:backgroundTint="@color/accent_primary" android:textColor="@color/accent_on" app:cornerRadius="32dp" />
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/btnSaveProfile" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Guardar" style="@style/NunitoBoldButtonRounded" android:layout_marginTop="2dp" android:layout_marginStart="24dp" android:layout_marginEnd="24dp" android:layout_gravity="center_horizontal" android:backgroundTint="@color/accent_primary" android:textColor="@color/accent_on" app:cornerRadius="32dp" android:visibility="gone" />
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/btnCancelProfile" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Cancelar" style="@style/NunitoBoldButtonRounded" android:layout_marginTop="2dp" android:layout_marginStart="24dp" android:layout_marginEnd="24dp" android:layout_gravity="center_horizontal" android:backgroundTint="@color/accent_primary" android:textColor="@color/accent_on" app:cornerRadius="32dp" android:visibility="gone" /> </LinearLayout> </ScrollView>
